title: Use sibling scroll shell for responsive masthead
description: Render one shared MastheadBar component twice at breakpoint-specific headers, and make app content the only overflow scroll region so the mobile action bar remains at the bottom without fixed positioning.
close_reason: Implemented shared MastheadBar dual render with sibling app-content scroll shell and utility-class layout

title: Simplify masthead fixed positioning
description: Remove redundant responsive hook and inline positioning from the MastHead; use one fixed CSS rule to avoid sticky layer conflicts across routes.
close_reason: Removed redundant positioning fallbacks; fixed CSS is now the single authority

title: Remove sticky positioning from MastHead shell
description: Use a fixed MastHead shell so mobile bottom positioning does not depend on route-specific scroll containers.
close_reason: Replaced sticky shell with fixed positioning and verified home/profile scrolling

title: Keep mobile masthead fixed across gallery routes
description: Ensure the mobile masthead uses explicit fixed positioning consistently on the home gallery, profile, and artwork detail routes.
close_reason: Added explicit mobile fixed positioning classes and verified scroll behavior

title: Replace artwork media carousel with shadcn base carousel
description: Update the artwork route carousel to use the shadcn base carousel implementation while preserving artwork media rendering, navigation, and slide count behavior.
close_reason: Updated the artwork route to use the shadcn base carousel structure with responsive, in-bounds controls and preserved artwork spacing.

title: Centralize mobile breakpoint token and hide mobile Ratat wordmark
description: Replace the duplicated 880px responsive breakpoint with a shared Tailwind mobile token across classes, CSS media queries, and pagination behavior. Ensure the mobile masthead shows only the compact mark and never the Ratat text. Verify with tests, typecheck, and build.
close_reason: Centralized the mobile breakpoint as the Tailwind mobile token, applied it across responsive utilities and authored media queries, and hid the mobile Ratat wordmark. Verified live at mobile and desktop sizes; tests, typecheck, build, lint, and color lint pass.

title: Let mobile artwork fill available viewport height
description: On the artwork detail route, allow images whose aspect ratio permits it to expand vertically up to the mobile viewport while remaining edge-to-edge in width.
acceptance_criteria: On mobile, artwork remains full-width and may grow to the available viewport height without cropping; desktop behavior remains unchanged.
close_reason: Implemented responsive full-width, aspect-ratio-aware mobile media frame capped to the available dynamic viewport height.

title: Constrain mobile artwork descriptions
description: Add ProfileBio-style show more/less behavior to artwork descriptions on mobile so actions remain visible.
close_reason: Implemented shared expandable text for profile and artwork descriptions

title: Simplify pagination viewport state
description: Remove the redundant identity helper and object-valued internal context from the shared pagination module while preserving its public hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Pagination viewport context stores a boolean directly; callers retain existing behavior; web tests and typecheck pass.
close_reason: Stored viewport mode as a boolean, removed the identity helper/test, and kept deterministic pagination coverage.

title: Make mobile sidebar span full viewport width
description: The artwork sidebar currently offsets itself with a negative mobile margin but keeps the inner content width, leaving a right-side gap. Expand its mobile width to compensate for the wrap padding.
close_reason: Expanded the mobile sidebar width to offset the wrap padding and span the viewport

title: Improve mobile masthead and search action bar
description: Move the MastHead to a fixed bottom action bar on mobile, make search a mobile button that opens a search field above the bar, and keep desktop behavior unchanged.
close_reason: Implemented mobile bottom masthead action bar and panel search

title: Make artwork details more-by section full width on mobile
description: Update the artwork details page so the more-by section spans the full mobile width and its items have no gap at the mobile breakpoint.
close_reason: Updated the artwork details more-by section for full-width, gapless mobile layout.

title: Make artwork details Bluesky link rectangular
description: Replace the rounded pill styling on the Bluesky source link in artwork details with a rectangle-shaped treatment.
close_reason: Changed the artwork details Bluesky source link from pill-rounded to rectangular corners.

title: Improve mobile quick settings and avatar menu touch targets
description: On the mobile breakpoint, increase quick-settings icon button vertical size and make avatar dropdown items taller with larger text for thumb-friendly interaction.
close_reason: Added mobile touch-target sizing for quick settings and avatar menu items

title: "Hide home gallery item headers on mobile"
description: "Update the home gallery responsive presentation so gallery item headers are not visible on mobile screens."

title: Hide top pager on mobile
description: Hide the top pagination control on mobile viewports across shared profile and home gallery pages while preserving bottom and standalone pagers.
close_reason: Top pager now hides below 880px while other pager variants remain visible

title: Make masthead taller on mobile
description: Increase the mobile masthead height while preserving desktop sizing.

title: Migrate database during worktree startup
description: Ensure worktree startup runs database migrations.
close_reason: Worktree startup now runs database migrations
